caption: the omnitrix as a combat dial - ben's first console brawler with the full hero roster on tap.
about: Ben 10: protector of earth (2007) turns the omnitrix into the game's whole grammar: swap between heatblast, four arms, xlr8 and the rest mid-fight, each alien a different combat answer to the same alien-invasion problem. The beat-em-up loop is honest about its license and the show's voice cast carries it.
No windows build exists, so the platform is ps2 - played through pcsx2, rom sourced from romsfun.
